description: This file defines two functions, Release and Releases, that generate HTML components for listing software releases with different formats and download options. It utilizes external modules for version comparison and HTML generation, and exports the main 'Releases' function.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Generates an unordered list of release versions with links or labels, based on provided properties.

methods.name: Releases
methods.description: Generates an HTML block displaying multiple releases with download links and version differentiation.
